name: band single leg calf raise
description: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.
instructions: Place the ball of one foot securely on a low step and loop a resistance band over that foot, holding the other end.
Use a stable support for balance and raise your heel slowly onto the ball of your foot.
Pause at the top, then lower your heel with control and switch legs after your reps.
